reviews.title: Annotation Preview Update reverts even without an explicit Cancel, when selection moves away
reviews.primaryContract: A transient annotation preview is removed when selection changes, without mutating canonical state.
reviews.reason: The annotation overlay preview lifecycle is user-visible and owner-specific; the similar Clock test exercises a different renderer and draft owner, so title similarity is not duplicate coverage.

reviews.title: Clock Preview reverts even without an explicit Cancel, when selection moves away
reviews.primaryContract: A transient Clock waveform preview is removed when selection changes, without mutating canonical state.
reviews.reason: The Clock waveform preview uses a distinct renderer and draft owner from annotation overlay preview; keep the independent visible regression journey.

reviews.title: Apply commits the previewed draft as one real SemanticCommand
reviews.primaryContract: Applying a previewed Annotation draft commits the same values through one semantic command.
reviews.reason: The visually similar Clock test protects a separate editor and waveform projection; it does not replace Annotation command application coverage.

reviews.title: Apply after Preview commits exactly the previewed draft as one real SemanticCommand
reviews.primaryContract: Applying a previewed Clock draft commits the previewed generator through one semantic command.
reviews.reason: The Annotation counterpart cannot prove Clock waveform preview/application equivalence, so retain both product journeys.

reviews.title: Bottom Editor splitter resizes and collapses without changing document or render state
reviews.primaryContract: Bottom splitter interaction changes panel size/visibility without Canonical, History, Dirty, or render-session changes.
reviews.reason: Inspector resize is a similar gesture but has a different axis, owner, state, and layout consequence; a shared low-level drag unit test would not replace this observable contract.

reviews.title: Inspector splitter resizes and collapses without changing document or render state
reviews.primaryContract: Inspector splitter interaction changes panel width/visibility without Canonical, History, Dirty, or render-session changes.
reviews.reason: Bottom resize differs in orientation and layout owner; keep this as the user-visible inspector-specific journey rather than merging by title similarity.

reviews.title: Transaction Open reaches first useful paint for small fixture at 1280x720
reviews.primaryContract: Small Transaction document open reaches useful Transaction projection at compact viewport.
reviews.reason: This is a small-fixture baseline at compact viewport; it differs in fixture size and purpose from the separate 500-Transaction scalability budget test. Runtime has not yet been measured.

reviews.title: Transaction Open reaches first useful paint for small fixture at 1672x941
reviews.primaryContract: Small Transaction document open reaches useful Transaction projection at desktop viewport.
reviews.reason: Desktop viewport is retained as a responsive/performance comparison against 1280x720; runtime has not yet been measured.

reviews.title: Transaction Open reaches first useful paint for medium fixture at 1280x720
reviews.primaryContract: Medium Transaction document open reaches useful Transaction projection at compact viewport.
reviews.reason: Medium fixture adds a scale point to the startup curve, not duplicate acceptance of the 500-Transaction case. Runtime has not yet been measured.

reviews.title: Transaction Open reaches first useful paint for medium fixture at 1672x941
reviews.primaryContract: Medium Transaction document open reaches useful Transaction projection at desktop viewport.
reviews.reason: Desktop viewport is retained as a responsive/performance comparison against 1280x720; runtime has not yet been measured.

reviews.title: 500-Transaction Open reaches first useful Transaction paint at 1672x941
reviews.primaryContract: A large Transaction document produces a non-zero visible bar projection after Open.
reviews.reason: This is the large-scale stress point with its own 500-Transaction fixture and explicit scalability assertions; it is not a duplicate of small/medium startup checks. Runtime has not yet been measured.

reviews.title: 500-Transaction Open reaches first useful Transaction paint at 1280x720
reviews.primaryContract: A large Transaction document produces a non-zero visible bar projection at compact viewport.
reviews.reason: Compact viewport stresses available workspace and row projection separately from desktop; runtime has not yet been measured.

reviews.title: J1-3 fresh -> Cycle: renders, view-only, no errors
reviews.primaryContract: A fresh application can enter Cycle mode without changing Canonical, History, or Dirty state and without runtime errors.
reviews.reason: Representative fresh-state Cycle entry journey; complementary Transaction and Combined entries are also retained in the same product lifecycle contract suite.

reviews.title: J1-3 fresh -> Transaction: renders, view-only, no errors
reviews.primaryContract: A fresh application can enter Transaction mode without changing Canonical, History, or Dirty state and without runtime errors.
reviews.reason: Transaction workspace has a separate initialization/projection path, so this user-visible mode entry complements Cycle and Combined smoke journeys.

reviews.title: J1-3 fresh -> Combined: renders, view-only, no errors
reviews.primaryContract: A fresh application can enter Combined mode without changing Canonical, History, or Dirty state and without runtime errors.
reviews.reason: Combined composes two view owners and needs its own real startup journey; this is not covered by either single mode.

reviews.title: J4/J16 Cycle -> Transaction -> Combined -> Cycle, then rapid switching, stays view-only and error-free
reviews.primaryContract: Mode transitions and rapid switching preserve document/history state and keep the application error-free.
reviews.reason: This is the direct cross-mode lifecycle invariant and exercises state transitions that static/unit tests cannot fully prove.

reviews.title: J5/J10 select -> edit -> Apply -> Undo -> Redo, and an unapplied draft does not leak to the next selection
reviews.primaryContract: Selection changes discard an unapplied draft; Apply creates one history step and Undo/Redo restore the committed state.
reviews.reason: This production journey covers cross-selection draft isolation plus the visible Apply/Undo/Redo contract, which is not reducible to a single unit invariant.

reviews.title: J9 Bottom follows the selected entity kind
reviews.primaryContract: Bottom panel follows the selected entity kind across the actual application surface.
reviews.reason: The selected entity kind drives a cross-surface panel contract that is appropriately verified at the UI boundary.

reviews.title: Transaction tree selection opens the selected canonical transaction in Inspector
reviews.primaryContract: Selecting a Transaction in the Tree selects that same canonical entity in Inspector and applies edits to it.
reviews.reason: This is the focused Transaction selection/Inspector production route and is a small changed-domain browser journey.

reviews.title: #554 from-scratch Transaction workspace journey at 1672x941
reviews.primaryContract: Production-path Transaction creation, group/link edits, selection sync, Undo/Redo, mode round trips, and Save/New/Open preserve semantic data.
reviews.reason: This is a broad end-to-end lifecycle with real file save/open and many semantic operations. Keep out of ordinary focused PR verification, but retain as automated integration acceptance.

reviews.title: #554 from-scratch Transaction workspace journey at 1280x720
reviews.primaryContract: The same production-path Transaction lifecycle remains usable at a compact viewport while semantic edits survive Save/New/Open.
reviews.reason: The journey exercises responsive panel geometry and overflow-sensitive controls at 1280x720; the desktop variant is not a substitute for this width-specific contract.

reviews.title: locks v8 badge, display, MiniMap, and bottom-toolbar geometry
reviews.primaryContract: Role badge/frozen-column alignment, toolbar control grouping, and MiniMap stability remain within approved visual geometry.
reviews.reason: This single desktop geometry contract checks measurable visual relationships rather than a broad screenshot matrix; it belongs in the visual profile, not every semantic PR journey.
